items.rationale: Translating the police report is claim substantiation, excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f).
These are working materials raised alongside the translation charge, excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

The robbery is covered under 2.3.1. 7.1.9 limits the indemnity to an equivalent watch (about EUR 7,000), and the valuables sub-limit of EUR 2,500 per item under 4.2.2 then caps it at 2,500. Reference case 31 points to no separate deductible cut.

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: The roughly EUR 900 of cash is capped by the means-of-payment sub-limit of EUR 500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3.
The sunglasses were mislaid on a separate occasion, so they are excluded under 2.3.4(a) and are not an affected item.
Carriage and forwarding charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
